About the Position
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to own and grow the Data Science group - the R&D team behind Alice's security and safety AI models and the data platform that powers them. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers who ship real-time inference at scale, automated red-teaming of GenAI systems, and the Databricks/Spark data platform underneath. This is a hands-on people-leadership role: you set technical direction, are accountable for delivery and quality, and you build and grow the team.
What your team owns
The group is responsible for a large Python + Rust + PySpark monorepo (dozens of production services and shared libraries) spanning three connected domains:
1. Content-moderation inference at scale
Real-time, multi-tenant detection across text, image, video, and audio - hate speech, CSAM, nudity, child grooming, extremism, PII, prompt injection, age estimation, and more - served through an in-house ActiveServe framework over NVIDIA Triton and a Rust detection monolith, on latency-sensitive, SLA-bound, customer-facing traffic with per-customer custom models.
2. GenAI safety & red-teaming
Automated red-teaming that attacks customers' LLM applications with a research-driven attack taxonomy and measures attack-success rate, alongside the defensive side - LLM-as-judge escalation to cut false positives and the tooling that authors and refines moderation policies - built on a multi-provider LLM foundation (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI Grok) and forming Alice's leading edge into agentic-AI safety.
3. Data platform & MLOps
An end-to-end lakehouse and MLOps stack on Databricks - bronze/silver/gold ingestion, PySpark pipelines, and model training, versioning, and promotion through MLflow / Unity Catalog into Triton serving - with the performance-critical hot paths engineered in Rust (PyO3/maturin) for sub-millisecond, high-QPS matching and detection.
What you'll do
Lead and grow the team - mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers, and own hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, career development, and performance.
Set direction and deliver - set technical direction and standards, turn company and product goals into a prioritized roadmap, and own the quality, reliability, and delivery of the systems above across parallel workstreams.
Champion excellence and partnership - stay hands-on to review designs and unblock the team, drive engineering excellence (testing, observability, CI/CD, on-call, cost/latency), keep the team at the state of the art in ML, LLMs, and GenAI safety, and partner with Product, Platform, and GenAI-safety stakeholders.
Leadership competencies
People-first: builds trust, grows engineers, and creates a healthy, inclusive, high-ownership culture.
Outcome-oriented: drives clarity, sets priorities, and delivers under ambiguity without micromanaging.
Technical credibility: earns the team's respect through sound judgment on architecture and trade-offs.
Systems thinker: balances short-term delivery against long-term platform health, cost, and tech debt.
Requirements
What we're looking for (must-have)
Leadership & communication - a proven people manager of engineering or data-science teams (or a strong tech lead ready to step into formal management), with excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Hands-on engineering and ML at scale - strong production Python and software-engineering background with solid ML / data-science foundations (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring), running services at scale on AWS and Kubernetes and large-scale data on Spark/PySpark and a lakehouse (Databricks or equivalent).
AI-augmented engineering - deep, daily fluency with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex), with the judgment to raise the whole team's leverage and set how these tools are used well.
Nice to have
Experience with LLMs / GenAI in production - prompting, evaluation, guardrails, red-teaming, or agentic systems.
Experience with model serving on NVIDIA Triton (or similar) and the MLflow / Unity Catalog lifecycle.
Familiarity with Rust and Python/Rust interop (PyO3/maturin) for performance-critical paths.
Background in GenAI safety and security, content moderation, or another domain where model quality has real-world stakes.
Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).

One of the hardest parts of this role is that you’re both the visionary and the builder; the one drawing the map and paving the road.
That means switching between high-level strategy and hands-on experimentation daily, and doing it while bringing others along with you. There’s no playbook for this kind of work. You’re paving an unpaved road, one small experiment at a time.

description:
About the Position
We are hiring an Engineering Manager to own and grow the Data Science group - the R&D team behind Alice's security and safety AI models and the data platform that powers them. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers who ship real-time inference at scale, automated red-teaming of GenAI systems, and the Databricks/Spark data platform underneath. This is a hands-on people-leadership role: you set technical direction, are accountable for delivery and quality, and you build and grow the team.
What your team owns
The group is responsible for a large Python + Rust + PySpark monorepo (dozens of production services and shared libraries) spanning three connected domains:
1. Content-moderation inference at scale
Real-time, multi-tenant detection across text, image, video, and audio - hate speech, CSAM, nudity, child grooming, extremism, PII, prompt injection, age estimation, and more - served through an in-house ActiveServe framework over NVIDIA Triton and a Rust detection monolith, on latency-sensitive, SLA-bound, customer-facing traffic with per-customer custom models.
2. GenAI safety & red-teaming
Automated red-teaming that attacks customers' LLM applications with a research-driven attack taxonomy and measures attack-success rate, alongside the defensive side - LLM-as-judge escalation to cut false positives and the tooling that authors and refines moderation policies - built on a multi-provider LLM foundation (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, xAI Grok) and forming Alice's leading edge into agentic-AI safety.
3. Data platform & MLOps
An end-to-end lakehouse and MLOps stack on Databricks - bronze/silver/gold ingestion, PySpark pipelines, and model training, versioning, and promotion through MLflow / Unity Catalog into Triton serving - with the performance-critical hot paths engineered in Rust (PyO3/maturin) for sub-millisecond, high-QPS matching and detection.
What you'll do
Lead and grow the team - mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software engineers, and own hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, career development, and performance.
Set direction and deliver - set technical direction and standards, turn company and product goals into a prioritized roadmap, and own the quality, reliability, and delivery of the systems above across parallel workstreams.
Champion excellence and partnership - stay hands-on to review designs and unblock the team, drive engineering excellence (testing, observability, CI/CD, on-call, cost/latency), keep the team at the state of the art in ML, LLMs, and GenAI safety, and partner with Product, Platform, and GenAI-safety stakeholders.
Leadership competencies
People-first: builds trust, grows engineers, and creates a healthy, inclusive, high-ownership culture.
Outcome-oriented: drives clarity, sets priorities, and delivers under ambiguity without micromanaging.
Technical credibility: earns the team's respect through sound judgment on architecture and trade-offs.
Systems thinker: balances short-term delivery against long-term platform health, cost, and tech debt.
Requirements
What we're looking for (must-have)
Leadership & communication - a proven people manager of engineering or data-science teams (or a strong tech lead ready to step into formal management), with excellent communication and stakeholder management.
Hands-on engineering and ML at scale - strong production Python and software-engineering background with solid ML / data-science foundations (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring), running services at scale on AWS and Kubernetes and large-scale data on Spark/PySpark and a lakehouse (Databricks or equivalent).
AI-augmented engineering - deep, daily fluency with an AI coding assistant (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex), with the judgment to raise the whole team's leverage and set how these tools are used well.
Nice to have
Experience with LLMs / GenAI in production - prompting, evaluation, guardrails, red-teaming, or agentic systems.
Experience with model serving on NVIDIA Triton (or similar) and the MLflow / Unity Catalog lifecycle.
Familiarity with Rust and Python/Rust interop (PyO3/maturin) for performance-critical paths.
Background in GenAI safety and security, content moderation, or another domain where model quality has real-world stakes.
Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka, SQS) and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform).
About Alice
THE CHALLENGES ALONG THE WAY
1. Being Both Strategist and Executioner
One of the hardest parts of this role is that you’re both the visionary and the builder; the one drawing the map and paving the road.
That means switching between high-level strategy and hands-on experimentation daily, and doing it while bringing others along with you. There’s no playbook for this kind of work. You’re paving an unpaved road, one small experiment at a time.
‍
2. Balancing Security and Innovation
ActiveFence is the leading provider of security and safety solutions for online experiences, safeguarding more than 3 billion users, top foundation models, and the world’s largest enterprises and tech platforms every day.
As a trusted ally to major technology firms and Fortune 500 brands that build user-generated and GenAI products, ActiveFence empowers security, AI, and policy teams with low-latency Real-Time Guardrails and a continuous Red Teaming program that pressure-tests systems with adversarial prompts and emerging threat techniques. Powered by deep threat intelligence, unmatched harmful-content detection, and coverage of 117+ languages, ActiveFence enables organizations to deliver engaging and trustworthy experiences at global scale while operating safely and responsibly across all threat landscapes.

Healthcare Data Analyst
About the Company
Antidote Health is a tech- driven health insurance company on a mission to make healthcare easy, accessible, and more affordable. We’re rethinking how healthcare works—using technology to remove the friction, complexity, and delays that define the traditional system. Instead of navigating paperwork, long waits, and disconnected experiences, we’re building a simpler, more connected way for people to get care.
Our platform combines health coverage, virtual care, and a modern member experience into one seamless system designed to help people actually use their benefits.
We offer Affordable Care Act (ACA) health plans in Arizona and Ohio, and we’re growing quickly. We’re building a company focused on solving real problems—with real impact on people’s lives.
Position Overview
We are looking for an experienced Healthcare Data Analyst to join our Data department and help turn complex healthcare data into clear, actionable insights that improve business performance, member experience, operational efficiency, and healthcare outcomes.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical skills with curiosity about how healthcare works, together with the ability to communicate insights clearly and effectively in both English and Hebrew, verbally and in writing. This includes explaining the story behind the numbers, translating analysis into clear and actionable messages, and supporting stakeholder decision-making through discussions, reports, and presentations as needed.
You will work closely with business, medical, operations, finance, product, and technology teams, using data from areas such as Healthplan M embership, Medical Claims, Providers, medical Utilization, and customer interactions .
A successful Healthcare Data Analyst does more than produce reports. You understand the business question behind the request, determine which data can answer it, challenge questionable assumptions, validate the results, and turn the analysis into a clear recommendation or decision.
You will help us build a culture where data is trusted, understood, and used to drive action .
Key Responsibilities
Analyze healthcare data to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and operational issues.
Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs used by executive stakeholders.
Work with claims, enrollment, member, provider, utilization, and financial data.
Partner with stakeholders to understand their needs and help them translate business questions into data analysis that supports decisions.
Perform ad-hoc analyses supporting strategic and operational decisions.
Validate data quality and identify inconsistencies, missing data, or potential data pipeline issues.
Work with data engineering and analytics teams to improve data models and reporting infrastructure.
Support regulatory, operational, and management reporting when needed.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Qualifications
Required:
5+ years of experience in data analysis, healthcare intelligence, or a similar analytical role.
Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working with large datasets.
Experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau or similar.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Strong analytical thinking and ability to break ambiguous business questions into structured analyses.
Ability to communicate insights clearly and explain the story behind the numbers
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple business functions.
Master’s degree (with thesis) in a quantitative field such as Neurobiology, Bioinformatics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Industrial Engineering, Public Health, or a related discipline.
Healthcare Experience- preferred:
Relevant experience may include working with: health insurance or payer data, medical claims and utilization, healthcare operations, clinical or population-health data. Experience with concepts such as ICD, CPT/HCPCS, NPI, taxonomy, claims adjudication, prior authorization, risk adjustment, or healthcare quality measures is an advantage.
Preferred:
Experience building or working with semantic layers and standardized metric definitions.
Familiarity with US healthcare regulations and payer operations.
Experience working in a fast-growing or highly cross-functional organization.
Experience using AI tools to accelerate analytics, investigation, or reporting workflows.
Equal Opportunity Statement

Expert in Python with a focus on performance-driven techniques and optimization.

About The Role
As the BI&A Manager, you will own analytics and reporting across our go-to-market organization. This is a hands-on role for someone who can build the data infrastructure, dashboards, and metrics definitions that let Sales, Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership make decisions with confidence. You'll partner closely with your GTM Operations team members and cross-functional leadership to turn raw data from Salesforce and other GTM systems into trusted, self-service reporting — and to prepare the analyses that inform weekly and quarterly business reviews.
Requirements
5+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, or revenue operations, ideally within a B2B SaaS or technology company.
Proven experience owning BI strategy and delivery — not just building individual reports, but defining how a company measures and trusts its own data.
Strong SQL skills and hands-on experience with at least one modern BI platform (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Sigma, or similar).
Deep fluency with Salesforce data models and CRM-driven reporting; experience with SaaS revenue metrics (ARR/MRR, pipeline, churn, retention, NRR/GRR).
A track record of turning raw data into structured, executive-ready deliverables (dashboards, decks, and written analyses) for leadership audiences.
Excellent stakeholder management — able to push back constructively on requirements, methodology, or data interpretation when needed.
Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills alongside BI tooling.
Nice To Have
Experience with dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar modern data-stack components.
Familiarity with third-party enrichment or intent-data tools (e.g., HG Insights, Intricately, ZoomInfo, Apollo) and how they integrate with CRM data.
Prior experience supporting global GTM organizations spanning multiple regions (e.g., AMER and APAC).
Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or related) or equivalent experience.
Responsibilities
Own the end-to-end BI strategy for GTM analytics — from data modeling and metric definitions through dashboard delivery and adoption.
Define and govern a single source of truth for core revenue metrics (pipeline, bookings, ARR/MRR, churn, retention, NRR/GRR, funnel conversion) across Sales, Marketing, BDR, Partnerships, and SE teams in AMER and APAC.
Evaluate, select, and manage BI tooling, balancing build-vs-buy trade-offs against cost and maintainability.
Design, build, and maintain executive-ready dashboards and self-service reporting that support weekly and quarterly business reviews.
Translate ad hoc questions from Sales, Marketing, and executive stakeholders into structured, reusable analyses rather than one-off exports.
Build and maintain pipeline health, funnel, and productivity models that surface risk and opportunity early enough to act on.
Perform deep-dive analyses (cohort, segmentation, attribution, forecasting) to answer specific business questions and support strategic planning.
Partner with Systems teams to ensure Salesforce and adjacent GTM systems produce clean, well-governed, analytics-ready data.
Establish data quality monitoring, validation checks, and escalation paths for BI-critical tables and metrics.
Document metric definitions, data lineage, and reporting logic so outputs are trusted and reproducible across teams.
Act as the primary analytics point of contact for Sales, Marketing, BDR, Partnerships, and Solutions Engineering leadership.
What’s in it for you?
Competitive salary
Flexible, remote-first global environment
Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology
Equity options
Learning budget for professional and personal development, including access to international conferences and courses
Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues
Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need
Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance
Potential for personal growth and promotion as the company grows and success drives more hiring and more opportunities
Hiring process
Screening call with Recruiter
Hiring Manager interview
1-2 additional interviews based on the role
Culture Check interview with an executive
As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.

description: The engineering team at Chainalysis is inspired by solving the hardest technical challenges and creating products that build trust in cryptocurrencies. We’re a global organization with teams in Denmark, UK, Canada, the USA who thrive on the challenging work we do and doing it with other exceptionally talented teammates. Our industry changes every day and our job is to create user facing products supported by a flexible and scalable data platform allowing us to adapt to those rapid changes and bring value to our customers. We are building the data platform https://blog.chainalysis.com/reports/series-f/ for blockchain, cryptocurrency, and web3. Our engineers deeply understand what is possible with cloud-native technologies and use those insights to enable our customers to push the boundaries of the cryptocurrency landscape. Our Alterya team is focused on AI-powered fintech and threat intelligence, empowering institutions to protect individuals from fraud transactions. As a Data Analyst & Prompt Engineer, you will be responsible for designing and optimizing prompts for LLM models to efficiently extract the data the team needs. We are looking for someone who constantly asks questions to uncover deeper insights and better answers. You should be relentlessly focused on improving existing methods, challenging the status quo, and proactively seeking the best solutions for identified problems. The role will be based in Tel Aviv, and we are looking for eager, enthusiastic, curious, hard working and positive people to be part of our amazing journey. In this job, you'll: - Build LLM prompts and data flows - Research the web to find and define types of scams and scammers - Analyze and monitor our data pipelines using SQL - Work with Big Data Databases - Research customer and team requirements, analyze fraudulent and scam activity online, and create data-driven solutions to detect scammers effectively We’re looking for candidates who have: - 2+ years’ experience as a data analyst - Excellent analytical skills - Strong SQL skills with experience in querying large, complex data sets - Experience with Python data functions - Fluent English (written & verbal) - Good interpersonal communication skills - Quick grasp of new data and data systems Technologies we use: - Python - SQL - Blockchains AI at Chainalysis AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it. AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before. About Chainalysis Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation. You belong here. At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture. We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here https://go.chainalysis.com/rs/503-FAP-074/images/Interview%20Accommodations%20Request.pdf. We can’t wait to meet you.

Job Description
About the Role
Numbers tell stories. Compensation tells even better stories.
We are looking for a curious, analytical, and highly motivated Compensation & Benefits Analyst to join our Global Compensation & Benefits team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone early in their career who loves working with data, enjoys solving puzzles, and wants to learn how global organizations make decisions about employee pay, benefits, rewards, and workforce strategy.
You don't need to be a compensation expert yet - we will teach you that part.
What we're really looking for is someone who gets excited about Excel formulas, asks "why?" more often than most people, and isn't afraid to dive into large datasets until they reveal their secrets.
(Warning: prolonged exposure to this role may result in unexpectedly strong opinions about salary structures, market data, and pivot tables.)
What You'll Do
As part of our Global Compensation & Benefits team, you will:
Compensation Analytics & Benchmarking
Participate in salary benchmarking projects using leading market surveys and compensation databases.
Analyze internal and external compensation data to support competitive and equitable pay decisions.
Assist with the maintenance of salary ranges, job architecture, and compensation frameworks.
Support annual compensation cycles, including merit reviews, promotions, and salary adjustments.
Conduct compensation analyses and help prepare recommendations for managers and HR partners.
Data, Reporting & Insights
Partner with HR Operations on data management in the HR system (HRDB) - including uploads, audits, and ongoing maintenance of HR data - to safeguard data integrity across the employee lifecycle.
Build and maintain reports, dashboards, and analyses using Excel, Power BI, and HR systems.
Translate complex data into simple and actionable insights.
Support pay equity, workforce planning, and regulatory reporting initiatives.
Benefits & Total Rewards
Assist in the evaluation and administration of employee benefits programs.
Conduct market research and trend analysis on benefits and total rewards practices.
Support communication efforts to help employees understand our rewards programs.
Business Partnership
Partner with HR, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, and business leaders on compensation-related initiatives.
Contribute to projects that improve processes, governance, and the employee experience.
Continuous Improvement
Look for smarter, faster, and more efficient ways to work.
Leverage AI and technology tools to enhance reporting, analyses, and decision-making.
Bring fresh ideas and challenge existing assumptions.
This is a temporary position for 3 months
Qualifications
Required
Bachelor's degree in Economics, Statistics, Psychology, Business Administration, Human Resources, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Advanced Excel skills or a strong willingness to become an Excel wizard.
High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

description:
Cyabra helps global enterprises and governments restore trust and authenticity when manipulated content, coordinated behaviors, and inauthentic actors distort what’s real online. The solution analyzes who is operating, how activity is amplified, and how narratives are leveraged, translating evidence into clear mitigation steps teams can act on quickly. By reducing ambiguity and unnecessary reaction, Cyabra enables confident, proportionate action when clarity matters most.
Social media is increasingly being manipulated by bad actors, damaging the reputations of brands and individuals, spreading harmful content and consumer hate. Cyabra’s technology filters through social conversations to empower brands and marketing agencies to uncover coordinated inauthentic activity and discern people’s real sentiments online. Our powerful lens taps into hives of activity that are connected by common interests and passions to provide a deeper understanding of what drives consumers to help brands make smarter decisions.
We're looking for a highly analytical and curious Strategic Insights Consultant to join our Insights team. In this role, you will investigate online conversations, identify coordinated influence campaigns & emerging narratives, and transform complex social media data into clear, actionable insights for global clients.
A significant part of the role involves creating high-quality executive reports, marketing intelligence briefs, and client-facing analyses that communicate findings in a compelling and accessible way. You'll work closely with our Go-To-Market teams, and present insights to clients.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with excellent writing and presentation skills, enjoys telling stories through data, and is comfortable engaging directly with clients.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Go-To-Market Support :

The Role
As a Senior Research Scientist, AI & Data Systems at Eon Research, you will conduct applied research at the intersection of AI, data systems, and large-scale storage. Working closely with Assaf Natanzon, VP and Chief Architect, you will explore challenging technical problems, publish research in leading peer-reviewed venues, file patents, and translate research breakthroughs into production-ready product capabilities.
This role is ideal for a researcher with a strong publication record, deep expertise in a relevant research area, and experience bringing research into real-world products.
Research Areas
Query Processing and Query Engines: Query optimization and execution over columnar and lakehouse formats, including Apache Iceberg and Parquet, as well as approximate query processing using sketches and synopses.
Storage Systems: Deduplication, compression, and data layout optimization for large-scale storage.
Data Integration and Discovery: Entity resolution, schema matching, table joinability, and data discovery, including the use of LLMs as judges.
Information Retrieval and RAG: Retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise data, including emails, documents, and databases.
LLM Evaluation and Benchmarking: Evaluation frameworks and benchmarks for LLM agents working with enterprise data.
LLMs for Software Engineering: CI failure diagnosis, automated debugging, and program repair.
Requirements
PhD in Computer Science or a closely related field. The degree must be completed; candidates currently pursuing a PhD will not be considered.
A deep, sustained research track record in at least one of the relevant areas listed above.
Publications in strong peer-reviewed conferences, such as VLDB, SIGMOD, ICDE, SIGIR, CIKM, FAST, OSDI, USENIX ATC, ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ICSE, or FSE, depending on the research area.
At least 5 years of industry research experience, including work that has been deployed in production.
Hands-on experience with LLMs, including prompting, fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA, model evaluation, and running batch inference on GPUs.
Strong Python skills and the ability to independently design, implement, and execute end-to-end experiments.
Excellent written English and the ability to communicate complex research findings clearly.
Nice to Have
Experience in storage, backup, data protection, or enterprise data management.
Research or engineering experience with query engines, lakehouse formats, or approximate query processing.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Patents or a track record of translating research into intellectual property.
Experience working with enterprise data sources, including Microsoft 365, email, documents, and databases.

You’ll own end-to-end commission operations for a global population of 400+ Sales and CS employees, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, People, and Revenue Operations teams. This is a high-impact role focused on commission calculations, plan implementation, reporting, dispute resolution, and continuous process improvement, where accuracy, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration are essential.

responsibilities

Surface outliers and recommend design changes where plans aren't performing as intended.

Manage Adjustments & Corrections Process approved manual adjustments, retro changes, and exception cases, and keep an eye on patterns across them that point to a bigger fix needed elsewhere.
Investigate Discrepancies & Disputes Analyze payout issues and employee inquiries using data and how the system is built to calculate them, and feed common themes back into plan or process improvements.
Support System Changes & Testing Test and validate changes to plans, calculation rules, and integrations before release, including their impact on affected employees.

Collect data and prepare analyses in support of ad-hoc client requests
Knowledge And Experience
Undergraduate degree required
1-4 years’ experience in the financial and/or market data industry
Basic knowledge of financial instruments and markets is a plus but not required provided the candidate demonstrates strong basic skills
Good organizational skills with keen attention to detail.

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential

Role Overview
We are seeking a hands-on, highly analytical Senior Experimental Scientist to join our multidisciplinary R&D team. In this pivotal role, you will design and execute complex optical and physical experiments, lead root-cause investigations, and bridge the gap between early-stage physics research and scalable manufacturing.
This role requires deep scientific curiosity, a strong "hands-on" lab presence, and the leadership ability to rally cross-functional task forces toward key technical milestones in a fast-paced environment.
Key Responsibilities
Experimental Design & Execution: Plan, build, and execute complex optical, physical, and opto-mechanical experiments to validate and optimize novel photonic assemblies and packaging processes.
Diagnostics & Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct system-level diagnostics, troubleshooting, and failure analysis (RCA); define mitigation plans, robust system calibration protocols, and product transfer to manufacturing.
Lab Setup & Automation: Develop, implement, and maintain custom experimental setups, measurement techniques, and automated test environments.
Task Force Leadership: Lead small, cross-functional task forces (optics, materials, process engineering, algorithms) to solve critical R&D and process challenges.
Data & KPI Tracking: Analyze experimental data, define data-driven KPIs, and track technical progress in a results-oriented environment.
Documentation & Operations: Operate advanced laboratory instruments and optical test systems; document procedures, results, and conclusions systematically.
Qualifications & Requirements
Education: Advanced degree (M.Sc. or Ph.D.) in Physics, Applied Physics, Optics, or a related discipline.
Experience: 7+ years of hands-on experience in experimental research and system engineering, preferably within optics, photonics, or the semiconductor industry.
Lab Expertise: Proven experience designing, building, and interpreting complex physical or optical experimental setups directly on the bench.
Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional collaborative and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to motivate and align multidisciplinary teams.
Analytical Mindset: Systematic, methodical approach to complex technical troubleshooting with a proactive, solution-oriented attitude.
Environment: Comfort working under tight timelines in a fast-evolving, high-growth environment.
Ways to Stand Out
Direct hands-on experience with fiber optics, optical coupling, or photonic packaging (Silicon Photonics).
Background in semiconductor inspection/metrology equipment, precision alignment, or micro-optical assembly.
Experience in both corporate R&D (e.g., semiconductor capital equipment) and fast-paced startup environments.
Practical experience with optical simulation, automation, or data analysis tools (e.g., Zemax, Python, MATLAB).

description:
Description
About Immunai:
Immunai is an AI-driven platform company focused on improving drug discovery and development by decoding the human immune system.
We combine large-scale single cell immune data, advanced machine learning, and strong engineering to help pharmaceutical and research partners make better, more informed decisions throughout the drug development process.
Our long-term goal is to reduce drug development failure rates and help more effective medicines reach patients. We’re building this platform thoughtfully and collaboratively, bringing together expertise across biology, AI, engineering, and business.
Immunai is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
About the role:
﻿ We seek an exceptionally motivated Scientist II, Systems Immunologist to join our team of talented researchers in a highly collaborative startup environment at the intersection of immunology, AI, and new genomic technologies. This position offers an opportunity to work on a diverse set of projects related to human immunology, with a focus on cancer immunology and autoimmunity, in support of multiple projects.
Watch the video to learn more about Immunai's culture, and how the External Collaborations team is driving the next generation of oncology and immunology discoveries.
Location: New York, NY (Hybrid position)
Reporting to: Systems Immunology Team Lead
What will you do?
Serve as an immunology subject-matter expert on internal and external collaboration projects.
Utilize your computational skills as part of the External Collaborations dry lab team (Systems Immunologists & Computational Biologists).
Independently contribute to project planning, including goals, activities, and timelines
Lead the translation of data analysis to biological insights with the goal of generating actionable recommendations to inform drug development
Take an active role in shaping Immunai’s bioinformatic platforms to reflect immunological insights
Clearly communicate concepts and findings to external stakeholders in the form of presentations and data reports
Perform literature reviews to establish and maintain a deep understanding of project-specific immunological concepts, and simultaneously maintain a broad understanding of the most current updates in the field, specifically as it relates to immunotherapies, immunology, and single-cell technologies
Independently advise computational teams on matters of immunology
Requirements
Required qualifications:
Ph.D. in immunology or closely related field - A MUST
A minimum of 2-5 years of related experience (postdoc or industry)
Hands-on experience dealing with single-cell RNA sequencing including coding and data analysis in R (preferred) or Python - A MUST
Experience with multimodal single-cell data such as CITE-seq, TCR/BCR-seq, or spatial approaches is a plus.
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Strong analytical skills, problem-solving ability, attention to detail, and innovation aptitude
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively as part of a team
Excellent organization and time management skills, with an ability to multitask
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
Desired personal traits:
You want your work to contribute to better therapeutic decisions and ultimately improve patient outcomes.
You prioritize “We” over “I”
You enjoy getting things done and striving for excellence
You collaborate effectively with people of diverse backgrounds and cultures
You have a growth mindset
You are candid, authentic, and transparent
Compensation: This position offers a base salary typically between $130,000 and $150,000. There is an opportunity to consider higher compensation above this range based on business need, candidate experience, and or skills.
*Please note that when you apply for a position at Immunai, your application will be processed via our recruitment platform Comeet. You can read more about how we process personal data here: https://www.immunai.com/privacy-policy/

About the role
We're looking for a Data Science Team Lead to found and lead our new data science team. You'll report directly to our VP R&D. For the first few months you'll be our first and only data scientist, building the prediction engine behind our staffing platform hands-on. Then you'll hire and grow a team under you.
Census prediction: forecast how many patients each hospital unit will have, shift by shift, from hours to weeks ahead, using admissions, discharges, transfers, seasonality and hospital-specific patterns.
Patient acuity: model how sick patients are and how much nursing care they need, based on clinical data such as vitals, diagnoses, orders and nursing assessments.
Nursing workload: combine census and acuity into workload predictions that drive how nurse shifts are planned and assigned.
Clinical data: work hands-on with EHR records and ADT feeds from hospitals: messy, incomplete and full of signal.
Own models end to end , from exploration and validation to production and monitoring.
Build the team: define the DS roadmap, hire your first data scientists, and set the team's standards and practices.
About you
You are highly motivated and excited to work at an early-stage company
7+ years as a data scientist, with models running in production
Experience leading or mentoring data scientists, or a strong desire to build and lead a team
Comfortable being hands-on as a solo DS before the team grows
Strong hands-on experience with time-series forecasting and classification models
Strong Python and SQL
An advantage is given to those with experience in healthcare or clinical data (EHR, ADT, HL7/FHIR)

Experience level: Senior. Description: Jazz is a fast-growing cybersecurity startup rebuilding data loss prevention for the AI era. Design and implement the databases, ELT/ETL pipelines and orchestration on a medallion architecture that other people can safely build on top of. • Own the gold layer as the single source of truth. Modeled, tested, documented and trusted, the layer the company argues from, not about. • Define the company's metrics. Work with leadership to define organizational KPIs, instrument them, and keep the definitions honest as the business changes. • Build dashboards that executives actually use. Sales and GTM (pipeline, funnel, forecast, Salesforce data), R&D (delivery, quality, product usage), Finance and Operations. • Run it in production, at scale. Reliability, data quality, alerting and monitoring, including active tracking and reduction of infrastructure and warehouse costs. • Set the standards. Modeling conventions, testing, documentation, access control, and how BI requests get intake and prioritized. • Make things happen across the org. Present, persuade, and drive alignment between stakeholders who define the same metric three different ways. • Work with AI as a multiplier. You can point to a specific executive view you built and the decisions it changed. • Experience defining organizational metrics and securing cross-functional agreement on them. • Hands-on experience with Salesforce data - the object model, its quirks, and how to model it reliably. • Ownership of production data infrastructure at scale, including cost monitoring and optimization. • Strong presenter and communicator. You can hold a room of executives, bring a debate to a decision, and bridge between stakeholders who disagree. • Fluent in English and Hebrew. • ﻿Why join Jazz? • You're the architect, not the maintainer. There is no legacy warehouse to inherit and no one else's conventions to work around. The decisions you make in your first six months are the ones Jazz lives with. • Real data volume from day one. A forensic endpoint agent across enterprise fleets produces serious telemetry. This is a scale and cost problem worth solving, not a dashboard job with a data title. • Proximity to the decisions. Your dashboards are the ones the exec team opens on Monday morning. You'll sit in the room where the metric gets defined, not receive the definition by email. • AI-native! Our product is built on agentic AI and so is the way we work. Heavy AI use isn't tolerated here, it's the expectation. • Stage and backing. $61M from Glilot and Team8, out of stealth in March 2026, founded by Unit 81 veterans who have built and scaled security products before. Early enough that ownership is real, funded enough that the runway is too. • A team worth joining. • Our office is at Sonol Tower in Tel Aviv, next to Carlebach train station. •

Justt helps many of the world's largest and most recognizable brands turn chargebacks from a constant headache into a managed, predictable part of doing business. Our AI-driven platform powers chargeback operations at scale, automating disputes end to end, recovering revenue that would otherwise be lost, and removing a major operational burden from finance, risk, and operations teams across multiple regions and verticals.
We're a global company with teams across markets and disciplines, working closely with leading players in the payments ecosystem. Our culture is built on clear thinking, collaboration, and a strong sense of ownership. At Justt, you'll partner with product, engineering, data, success and go-to-market teams to build technology that sits at the core of modern payments, and has a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line for some of the biggest companies in the world.
Role Overview
The Payments Analyst plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of chargeback-related data across multiple platforms and internal systems. This position combines strong research, analytical and technical skills with cross-functional collaboration to support efficient chargeback management operations and enhance data-driven decision-making.
This role also acts as a connective layer between Operations and Engineering — translating operational issues into technical investigations, and technical findings back into clear operational context.
What You'll Do

About Kobre & Kim
Analyst I Job Description (U.S., Tel Aviv, or Cayman)
Kobre & Kim is a global law firm focused exclusively on disputes and investigations, with a strength in complex cross-border matters. The firm’s work spans financial products and services litigation, insolvency disputes, intellectual property litigation, international judgment enforcement and asset recovery, and U.S. government enforcement and regulatory investigations.
Kobre & Kim has achieved significant results for clients in high-stakes, cross-border matters. Recent successes include winning a US $604.9 million jury verdict and a total award exceeding US $833 million for a green fuel company in a landmark U.S. trial as well as securing the dismissal in the English courts of the Kingdom of Spain’s challenge to recognition of a €120 million ICSID award.
Your Impact
Our Analysts are an elite cohort of early-career individuals who gain substantive, hands-on experience supporting complex international civil and criminal financial litigation. As members of case teams, Analysts work alongside attorneys and business professionals, with exposure to client matters, pro bono work, knowledge management and global business development. The work is varied and fast-paced, with responsibilities adapting to the needs of each matter.
We are seeking intellectually curious graduates with strong research, writing, analytical and problem-solving skills. An interest in law, disputes, investigations or financial markets is a plus, but a legal background is not required .
As Analysts progress, they develop highly desirable transferable skills in research and problem-solving, financial and quantitative analysis, project and matter management, and written and verbal communication. These skills open doors across a wide range of careers and industries. Our alumni have gone on to pursue diverse paths, from careers in law and business to opportunities across other industries and professional fields. Those pursuing legal careers have gone on to leading law schools, including Yale, Harvard and Stanford, and secured training contracts with prominent law firms. The breadth of our alumni outcomes reflects the range of opportunities that a Kobre & Kim Analyst experience can unlock.
Key Responsibilities
Attend court hearings and client meetings under attorney supervision.
Support preparation for court appearances (including trials), client meetings, and witness interviews.
Coordinate with local counsel, experts, investigators and other external service providers in support of cross-border matters.
Conduct factual and financial analysis in support of complex matters.
Conduct legal research under attorney supervision.
Draft court documents under attorney supervision.
Review and analyze disclosure and legal documents under attorney supervision.
Manage day-to-day case and matter administration.
Prepare attorney and client binders.
Maintain case and firm information systems.
Career Development
Analysts join the firm as Analyst I and, after their first year, may pursue opportunities, including advancement to Analyst II, leadership roles, specialization in practice areas, and potential transfers to other departments or offices worldwide. Advancement is based on performance, skill development, contributions to the team, quality of work and ability to take on increasing responsibility.
Qualifications
Genuine interest in Kobre & Kim’s work and commitment to remain with the firm for a minimum of two years. (required)
Bachelor’s degree from a four-year university with a strong academic record. (required)
Graduates from all academic backgrounds are encouraged to apply, including STEM, finance, social sciences and humanities.
Work authorization for your preferred location(s). (required)
Strong academic, analytical, research and written communication skills. (required)
Ability to work outside standard business hours as needed, including late nights, weekends, and holidays, depending on assignments.
Excellent teamwork, organization, project management, and attention to detail, with creative and anticipatory thinking skills.
Strong work ethic, proactivity, and ability to perform under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
Professional proficiency in one or more of the following languages is a plus: Korean, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese, Hebrew, Mandarin, Cantonese, French, Arabic, German, Italian, and Japanese.
The Analyst Experience
Analysts receive a competitive compensation and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional development, mentorship, and meaningful exposure to the firm’s work, including:
Two weeks of study leave and an exam preparation stipend for relevant examinations.
An attorney mentor and stipend to support mentorship activities.
Regular team events and activities.
Language learning stipend.
Opportunities to travel subject to case needs.
Additional benefits disclosed at the offer stage.
Application Instructions
Candidates should submit a single PDF application for the cohort they are eligible for and prefer to join, based on their graduation date and availability to start on January 19, 2027 , or June 21, 2027 . Applicants should not apply for both cohorts. Please submit your application through Workday. Incomplete applications may limit our ability to effectively evaluate a candidate’s qualifications.
Required Application Materials
Resume/CV (include cumulative GPA and final/expected degree)
Cover letter
Unofficial academic transcript or documentation of academic performance
Two writing samples*
Writing samples should be argumentative or research papers written in English for college coursework or independent projects. Each sample should be no more than 10 pages. Full papers (5-10 pages) or excerpts from longer works are acceptable.
Review Process
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and candidates are encouraged to apply early. Applicants selected to interview will be contacted via email.

Exceptional attention to detail and a high standard for data accuracy, with the ability to independently identify and resolve discrepancies.
Proven ability to take ownership, build structure in ambiguous and fast-moving environments, and drive processes through to completion.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across functions.
Fluent in English – must feel comfortable working in English (reading, writing, and speaking).

About The Position
Longevity AI is on a mission to give everyone more healthy & happy years. Our team has built a comprehensive, medical-grade, evidence-based operating system: for medical teams, the Longevity Dashboard predicts & prevents the chronic diseases of aging — responsible for over 90% of our unhealthy years. For members, the Longevity App generates personalized health & lifestyle plans that adapt in real time, suggesting small nudges with the highest potential impact on their health.
Our Tel Aviv team is looking for a Data Science Team Lead to lead the efforts behind our AI model. A key part of it is based on the ongoing research with Israel's two largest HMOs, Maccabi and Clalit— the world's largest longevity research program, spanning over 1.6 million health records and decades of longitudinal data.
Working closely with our physicians, scientists, data engineers, movement and nutrition experts, you'll set the technical direction for this research: designing and running data experiments that optimize clinical predictions of age-related disease, and translating those findings into prevention strategies our medical team and members can act on. You will also lead the development of Florence - our main agent. Based on the first modern nurse - Florence Nightingale that saved millions of lives.
This is a high-conviction high-ownership role. You'll be trusted to lead deep technical decisions, build the team, become part of the company’s leadership and represent our world-leading capabilities in conferences.
We are looking for a leader. Passionate about delivering Longevity for All.
What You'll Do
Build the infrastructure that delivers healthy years to humanity.
Leading a talented multidisciplinary team and working closely with the company’s leadership, CTO and CEO.
Own end-to-end data science research on our HMO longitudinal datasets — from experiment design through clinical validation.
Set technical direction and best practices for the data science function, lead other data scientists, engineers ,analysts and experts.
Turn messy, real-world medical data into rigorous, defensible clinical predictions — and communicate it to non-technical stakeholders.
Partner with data engineering on the data pipeline and with product on translating predictions into member-facing nudges.
Bring modern AI tooling into the research workflow where it genuinely speeds things up — without compromising clinical rigor or data governance.
What We're Looking For (Must-Haves)
5+ years as a data scientist, including experience leading a team or a significant project with leading people to notable measurable results.
3+ years working with medical/health data.
A track record of leading a significant health-related project to real, measurable outcomes.
Excellent data-driven communicator — comfortable presenting findings to physicians and executives.
English - Fluent
Bonus Points
Background in behavioral science / psychology — directly relevant, since our product is built on behavior-change “nudges,” not just prediction.
Experience with causal inference / epidemiological methods (cohort studies, survival analysis) — standard for longitudinal, HMO-scale data.
Understanding population health.
Hands-on comfort using AI agents and LLM tooling to accelerate the research workflow (e.g., agent-assisted feature engineering, literature review, pipeline QA) — a strong plus, evaluated in interview rather than a filter on the resume.
Nice to Have
Tools: AWS, Git, Jira, Python
MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Biostatistics, or a related field

At Medtronic you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation, while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You’ll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world.
A Day in the Life
In this role, you will join a world-class team of engineers within the Surgical Operating unit responsible for developing medical devices that focus on lung cancer diagnosis.
Medtronic’s Surgical Operating Unit is a new, powerful operating unit bringing together the people and product portfolio of Surgical Robotics and Surgical Innovations. With the Medtronic Mission as our North Star, we will build on our legacy of proven surgical solutions and advance the promise of robotics and digital solutions to benefit our customers and patients.
Make your impact by exploring a career with the world’s leading Medical Device company, striving “to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life.”
Join a growing Algorithm team at the forefront of AI innovation in real-time medical interventional procedures. In this role, you will tackle complex technical challenges, shape solutions with meaningful clinical impact, and help define the next generation of intelligent medical technologies. You will be part of an innovation-driven environment that encourages curiosity, bold thinking, and continuous learning, while working alongside talented and supportive people who are committed to both professional excellence and personal growth. Together, you will contribute to technology that has the potential to make a real difference in patients’ lives.
Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Lead a team of high-performing researchers to develop innovative algorithmic solutions that support and advance our medical device from the fields of Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Image Processing
Represent the algorithm team in global forums and communicate ongoing progress, key results, risks, and challenges to global stakeholders
Lead the algorithm development lifecycle: research, design, implement, validate, document and optimize algorithms for our products
Provide technical direction and mentorship to algorithm developers; conduct design/code reviews and ensure best practices and high-quality deliverables
Partner with Data, Software, Systems, Clinical, and Product teams to define requirements, plan milestones, manage risks, and drive end-to-end delivery from prototyping to production
Required Knowledge and Experience:
MSc. or PhD in Computer Science/Software Engineering/EE/other relevant field - MUST
Proficiency and proven experience in developing, optimizing, validating, and deploying machine learning algorithms, deep learning techniques, and AI models to production
Passion for continuous learning and staying updated on AI advancements and trends
7+ years of R&D experience (algorithms / ML), including ownership of end-to-end delivery
Proven leadership experience (team lead / tech lead), including mentoring, prioritization, and driving execution across multiple stakeholders
3+ years of hands-on experience in Python (ability to lead by example with production-quality code)
Team player with very strong leadership and communication skills; able to influence and align across R&D and cross-functional stakeholders
Structured problem solver with sound technical judgment and data-driven decision making
High ownership: able to plan, prioritize, and drive tasks end-to-end while unblocking others and managing risks

Role Overview
The Associate Director, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations makes licensed real-world data fit for the studies and insights that depend on it. Claims, electronic health records are collected for care and billing, not for research. Each source brings its own challenges for new applications: gaps in enrollment, delayed resolution of claims, shifts between diagnosis coding versions. This person owns the path from a new data delivery to curated, documented, analysis-ready data a scientist can trust, and knows which of those problems matters for which question. They work on data platforms that IT and the enterprise platform teams own and run and bring the real-world data expertise those platforms need. Agentic AI coding tools are part of how they work every day.
Key Responsibilities
Real-World Data Curation
Assess each licensed claims, EHR and registry source for fitness for purpose before it is used: what it captures, and which questions it can and cannot answer.
Build and run the ingestion and curation pipelines that turn each delivery into analysis-ready data, handling enrollment and eligibility periods, claims lag and adjudication, and changes between coding-system versions.
Keep intact the details that change results, such as the decimal in an ICD-10 code, and document every transformation so a reviewer can trace any result back to the source files.
Map sources to common data models such as OMOP where reuse justifies it, and maintain the code lists, phenotype definitions and linkage rules that studies share.
Build standard cohorts and variables , with lookback and washout windows defined, so recurring questions do not start from raw data.
Check data quality and automated conformance, completeness and plausibility checks to inform each source’s fitness-for-purpose assessment.
Work with the platform teams on how each source is loaded, stored and refreshed, so a new data cut does not mean weeks of rework and routine cohort queries come back quickly.
Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks.
Agentic AI
Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely to write and test curation code, and maintain responsibility to review for quality and accuracy.
Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it.
Scientific & Strategic Leadership
Lead the design of standardized workflows which support complex non-interventional real-world studies and analytical strategies.
Strong understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose real-world evidence approaches.
Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions.
Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions.
Decision Enablement
Translate repeatable analyses into clear, actionable insights for decision-making using standardized approaches.
Support portfolio-level decisions on evidence generation, data selection and analytical strategy.
Help ensure standardized evidence approaches are relevant to the questions being asked and the decisions they’re meant to support.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT.
Work with IT and the enterprise data and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so curation work fits company architecture and security standards.
Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier.
Minimum Qualifications
PhD, or a Master’s degree with equivalent experience, in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, data science, computer science or a related quantitative field.
8+ years in real-world data or real-world evidence, including hands-on work preparing claims, EHR or registry data for research use.
Working command of the coding systems these sources use, such as ICD, CPT, NDC, ATC and LOINC, and of mapping between them.
Knowledge of how the way real-world data is collected shapes confounding, missingness and misclassification, and what that means for curation choices.
Solid grounding in observational study design and causal inference.
Strong Python and SQL, written with software engineering habits such as Git and automated testing. Enough R to work alongside analysts who use it.
Regular hands-on use of agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code on real projects, with the testing and review habits that keep the output trustworthy.
Clear communication of data choices and their consequences to scientists and decision makers.
Preferred Qualifications
OMOP CDM and OHDSI tools.
Experience with Israeli health data sources.
Linking or tokenizing patient records across real-world data sources.
Working on cloud data platforms with query performance in mind.
Computerized system validation (GxP) or other regulated data practice.
A publication record or open-source contributions in real-world data methods or tooling.
What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Role Overview
The Senior Scientist, Real-World Data & Evidence Foundations builds the software our scientists use to run real-world evidence analyses more efficiently, and makes sure the answers are right. These are epidemiology and statistics applications: cohort builders, incidence and prevalence estimates, treatment-pattern analyses, descriptive study reports. A tool like that can run perfectly and still be wrong, if a lookback window is off or a denominator is incorrectly defined. So this role pairs software development with enough epidemiology and statistics to know what a correct result looks like. This person owns each tool’s analytical logic, its test sets and its acceptance criteria, and builds the tools themselves with agentic coding tools. They build on the company’s shared AI and data platforms, which the data science and IT teams run.
Key Responsibilities
Real-World Evidence Tools
Build epidemiology and statistics applications that scientists use directly, from a simple front end to the analysis code behind it.
Implements each tool’s analytical logic: cohort entry, lookback and follow-up windows, denominators and statistical methods, agreed with the RWE scientists who will use the output.
Write the known-answer test sets and acceptance criteria every tool must pass before release, drawn from published studies and past analyses, and rerun them whenever the data or the code changes.
Turn validated analyses and agentic workflows that work for one person into tools the function can use, for tasks like literature screening or drafting code lists, with a person checking the output before it is used.
Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code routinely, and review what they produce as closely as a colleague’s work.
Align tools to the appropriate platforms and workstreams required (exploratory vs. regulatory submissions).
Work with the data science and IT teams that run the shared AI and data platforms when a tool needs enterprise deployment.
Work within company AI governance, and keep patient-level and licensed data out of any tool not approved for it.
Real-World Data Foundation
Build on the curated, analysis-ready data, standard cohorts and code lists that the real-world data curation team maintains
Apply the terms of each data license and data use agreement, including access controls, small-cell suppression and output checks.
Scientific & Strategic Leadership
Support the design of standardized workflows which support complex observational studies and analytical strategies.
Good understanding on how to frame research questions and define fit-for-purpose evidence approaches.
Contribute standardized workflows for evidence strategies that support development, regulatory and broader product lifecycle decisions.
Anticipate methodological and data risks and propose practical solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate across clinical development, biostatistics, regulatory, medical, HEOR, data science and IT.
Work with IT and the enterprise data, AI and platform teams, who own the shared infrastructure, so tools meet company architecture and security standards.
Build trusted working relationships that make execution and alignment easier.
Minimum Qualifications
PhD, or a Master’s degree with equivalent experience, in epidemiology, biostatistics, statistics, computer science, data science or a related quantitative field.
8+ years in real-world evidence, epidemiology, biostatistics or health data science, including hands-on development of analytical software that other people use.
Hands-on work with claims, EHR or registry data, and knowledge of how the way it is collected shapes confounding, missingness and misclassification.
Working knowledge of the epidemiological and statistical methods used in observational research, such as cohort designs, incidence and prevalence, survival analysis and confounding adjustment.
Strong Python and SQL, written with software engineering habits such as Git, automated testing and code review. Enough R to read and port analysts’ code.
Regular hands-on use of agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code on real projects, with the testing and review habits that keep the output trustworthy.
Clear communication of analytical and technical choices to scientists and decision makers.

Turning a validated analysis program into a reusable tool.
OMOP CDM and OHDSI analytics tools.

Modern web front-end development.

description:
What we are looking for:
Nova seeks an R&D Application Metrology Scientist to serve as the technical owner of application development throughout the Product Life Cycle in the Dimensional Metrology Division.
As part of this role, you will identify customer process metrology challenges, define application and technology requirements, validate new solutions through Alpha and Beta programs, and ensure new products deliver superior customer value and competitive differentiation.
In this role, you will work closely with customers worldwide, Marketing, Product Managers, R&D, and global Applications teams to translate advanced semiconductor process challenges into application requirements, methodologies, and future product capabilities.
This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on technical professional who combines deep metrology understanding, strong analytical capabilities, and customer-facing orientation.
What will you be doing:
Build strong technical relationships with customers worldwide to understand current and future semiconductor process metrology challenges.
Identify application gaps and define future applications, hardware, and algorithm requirements to support new product development.
Develop innovative metrology methodologies, simulations, and application benefits to enable advanced in-line process control solutions.
Support product line development by translating customer process challenges into application requirements and technical specifications.
Collaborate with R&D to define and validate new algorithms, metrology methodologies, and future technology capabilities.
Define application test plans, lead Alpha evaluations and wafer demonstrations at headquarters, and support product verification activities.
Lead first-customer Beta evaluations, collect customer feedback, and drive continuous product and application improvements.
Define tool specifications, application performance monitors, and acceptance criteria to ensure product readiness.
Support Product Customer Management and Marketing with technical positioning, application content, demonstrations, and marketing collateral.
Train and provide technical guidance to global Field Application Engineers on new applications, methodologies, and best practices.
Requirements:
Must Have requirements:
Master’s or Ph.D. degree in Physics, Materials Science, Electronics, Optics, or a related technical discipline.
Minimum of 3 years of experience in semiconductor metrology, process engineering, or advanced applications development.
Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and process control.
Experience with advanced metrology technologies such as OCD, Raman, Scatterometry, Spectroscopy, or related measurement techniques.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience in data analysis.
Proven ability to work directly with customers and collaborate across R&D, Marketing, Product Management, and Applications.
Excellent communication, presentation, and technical documentation skills.
Willingness to travel internationally.
Advantages :
Ph.D. in a relevant technical discipline.
Experience leading Alpha or Beta evaluations for semiconductor equipment or metrology solutions.
Experience developing metrology methodologies, simulations, application benefits, or performance monitors.
Experience training global Field Application Engineers or supporting customer demonstrations.
Experience with algorithm validation, advanced process control, or multidisciplinary product development.
That special something you bring in:
Deep technical curiosity and passion for solving complex semiconductor metrology challenges.
Excellent analytical thinking and ability to translate data into practical application insights.
Strong customer orientation and ability to build trusted technical relationships.
Ability to work in a multidisciplinary environment and connect application needs with product and technology development.
Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
Proactive, hands-on approach with strong ownership from concept through validation.
Ability to guide others, share knowledge, and support global teams with clarity and professionalism.
Get to know us better:
Nova (NASDAQ: NVMI) is a global company and a leading provider of innovative metrology solutions for process control in semiconductor manufacturing.
With a team of ~1200 people in three R&D centers and 27 field offices, we bring insights into the world’s most advanced industry. We leverage multiple technology fields such as physics, optics, chemistry, and algorithms to develop hardware and software solutions that measure almost every advanced computer chip built in the world.
Nova dives deep into dimensions and layers at the atomic level to extract unique insights and provide our customers with crucial decision-making data, managing critical challenges by providing unique, differentiated solutions.
Our outstanding people-focused and innovative culture means every person at Nova has the power to make an impact and significantly redefine what people can achieve through technology.
Join us if you are
A dreamer and brilliant high aimer who sees the impossible as the starting point and loves working in a multidisciplinary global team to create innovative breakthroughs.
If you need assistance due to a disability, you may contact us at talent@novami.com

About The Role
Data at Port only creates value when people can see it, trust it, and act on it. As Senior BI Analyst, you own that last mile: the BI platform everyone opens to answer their questions, and the KPI definitions that make sure the numbers on every dashboard mean the same thing across every team.
This is the business-facing anchor of our analytics function. You'll build and govern the reporting layer, define the metrics that leadership runs the company on, and lead the Business Analyst guild — the network of domain analysts embedded across GTM, Finance, CS, and Product. You're equal parts platform owner, metrics authority, and enabler of the analysts around you.
If you love turning messy business questions into clear, trusted, self-serve answers — and raising the analytical bar for a whole company while you do it — this role is for you.
What you’ll own:
Own the BI platform end-to-end — Design and manage the dashboard architecture, set standards for report building and certification, manage access/governance, and keep the platform performant and trusted
Define and govern company-wide KPI metrics — Build a certified KPI catalog with documented logic and ownership; arbitrate metric definitions across teams so "win rate" means the same thing everywhere and is encoded once in the semantic layer
Drive self-serve analytics adoption — Empower stakeholders to answer their own questions by making the platform accessible, intuitive, and built on trusted definitions
Co-lead the Analytics guild — Convene and lead the company-wide community of practice connecting domain analysts; run enablement, tooling decisions, and reviews to keep everyone aligned on standards and the certified KPI catalog
Bridge analytics and engineering — Partner with the AI Data Engineer to ensure business definitions translate consistently into technical implementations across dashboards and AI agents
What You'll Do Day To Day
Design, build, and maintain governed dashboards and reports that stakeholders actually use.
Curate the certified KPI catalog — definitions, logic, ownership, and change control.
Partner with GTM, Finance, CS, and Product to translate business questions into clear, reusable metrics.
Drive self-serve BI adoption and reduce ad-hoc reporting requests.
Run the Business Analyst guild: standards, reviews, enablement, and tooling.
Work with data engineering to keep KPI definitions aligned with the semantic layer and underlying models.
Own the health of the BI platform: access, performance, certification, and cleanup.
Requirements:
5+ years of hands-on experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or analytics roles in B2B SaaS companies.
Strong SQL and hands-on experience building analytics and dashboards in a modern BI tool (Omni, Looker, ThoughtSpot, Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Proven track record owning KPI/metric definitions and reporting for a business — not just building charts, but defining what's measured and why.
Excellent business judgment and stakeholder skills across GTM, Finance, and Product leaderships
A governance mindset: you care about a single source of truth and can hold the line on it.
Clear communication — you make complex data legible to non-technical audiences.
Nice to have
Experience owning or administering a BI platform (access, governance, semantic/metrics modeling).
Experience with a semantic layer or dbt-based metrics, and comfort partnering with data engineers.
Experience leading a guild, chapter, or community of practice — or driving standards without direct authority.
