Description: About the role • We are looking for an Analytics Lead to join our Data team in Tel Aviv, and to be the senior voice on product and business analytics of the company. • You own the systems and narratives that turn our data into commercial outcomes: less churn, more expansion, faster sales, and smarter testing across the merchant portfolio. You join a small, full-stack data team and work across the analyst domains it touches (CS, CRO, Sales, SaaS metrics, finance, marketing). This is a hands-on lead role: you ship the work yourself and set the analytical quality bar others work to. You are self-driving and curious, and you act as a force multiplier who roughly doubles what the rest of the company can do with data and insight. It is a senior individual-contributor role: no direct reports, real influence. • What you'll own • SaaS metrics, end to end. Own MRR, NRR, GRR, churn dollars, CAC, LTV, and payback, the monthly business close to Finance, and the metric definitions behind them. • Product analytics. Own how PDQ measures its own product (feature adoption, activation, impact) and the definitions behind it, moving it from reporting to decisions. • A/B learning that compound. Build the repository that mines patterns across wins and losses portfolio-wide, and feed the best ones back into the product and our AI agent. • A CRO framework for 200+ merchants. Design the system that scales (segmentation, opportunity scoring, recommended strategies, expected impact, measurement) and let our AI agent and CSMs run per-merchant execution on it. • Churn prevention, not churn reporting. Build the closed loop from churn signal to intervention to outcome, partnered with our data science team. Define what "saved" means and measure it. • Post-activation ROI and expansion. Quantify the value each merchant gets after go-live and turn it into a live per-merchant scorecard Sales and CS use in renewals and upsells. • Win/loss. Stand up the program from scratch: intake with Sales, a taxonomy, and a quarterly readout to leadership on why we win, why we lose, and what to change. • The Sales and CS partnership. Be the data team's primary partner to both, with a real feedback loop from the field into analysis. • Requirements: • 6+ years in applied analytics in SaaS, a product company, or e-commerce, with DTC, e-commerce, or B2B2C experience strongly preferred. • Full-stack analyst range: BI, data modeling, product analytics, experimentation and A/B testing, applied statistics, and churn analysis, with real depth in more than one of CS, CRO, Sales, SaaS metrics, finance, and marketing analytics. • A/B testing experience. This one is required: you have designed and analyzed experiments and can separate a real effect from noise. • Strong SQL and comfort in Python. Much of the technical part of analysis today is AI-generated. That reliance creates room for lower standards; we expect the opposite, so you read it closely and challenge it rather than trust it. • Stakeholder fluency: comfortable with a CFO, a Sales VP, and a CSM in the same hour, fluent in the KPIs each lives by, and able to communicate in business language rather than p-values. • A closed-loop instinct: not "report a metric" but "what changes because of this," with accountability for every number you ship. • A clear view of where AI helps analytics and where it creates risk, and the rigor to reject sloppy output. • High integrity, strong attention to detail, but equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves and doing hands‑on work. • Ability to work in our Tel Aviv office, four days a week • Full professional proficiency in English (written and spoken) • Strong advantages: Snowflake experience, and a real passion for online shopping, e-commerce, and consumer psychology, with genuine curiosity about how DTC shoppers behave. Also a plus: churn modeling, LTV/pLTV, win/loss frameworks, or B2B SaaS expansion analytics. •

You pick the problems, ship the work yourself, and set the bar for the analysts around you. • You think AI-first, and you build. When an analysis repeats, you turn it into a skill in MAXX, our AI analyst agent. When a team still works by hand, you automate it. You shape how PDQ uses AI, in the product and across the company. Segmentation, opportunity scoring and expected impact that MAXX and CSMs run per merchant. • Churn and expansion. Full professional English. • Advantages • E-commerce or DTC domain experience, on the product or merchant side. • Hands-on Snowflake experience. • Agentic analytics: semantic models an agent queries, MCP tools, and guardrails that stop an agent from inventing a number. • Good understanding of frequentist and Bayesian experimentation (sequential testing, CUPED, multiple-comparison control). • Churn, LTV or pLTV modeling. • How we hire • We use a home task with data, then a live session where you present it and we challenge it. שטראוס מגייסת מנהל.ת מרכז תובנות ומחקר
מה כולל התפקיד?
להוות אוטוריטה מקצועית בתחום המחקר ותובנות הצרכן, תוך שילוב מחקרים התנהגותיים, זיהוי חסמים ומגמות צרכניות ותרגומם לכדי תמונה אינטגרטיבית
ניהול צוות חוקרים מנוסה ומיומן, תוך שימת דגש על פיתוח היכולות המקצועיות בהתאם לאסטרטגיה המתגבשת
בניית תוכנית עבודה שנתית ורב-שנתית על בסיס האסטרטגיה העסקית, תעדוף שאלות עסקיות, מחקרים והשקעות בהתאם לערך ולהשפעה הצפויים
הצפת הזדמנויות, סיכונים ומנועי צמיחה, זיקוק מידע מורכב לכדי תובנות והמלצות ברורות לקהלי יעד שונים בארגון
הבטחת איכות ומתודולוגיה מקצועית, ניהול ספקים ותקציב, חיבור לכלים ומגמות מקצועיות בישראל ובעולם, בדגש על אימוץ AI והטמעת יכולות מתקדמות בתחום
מה חשוב להביא איתך לתפקיד?
ניסיון משמעותי בהובלת תחום המחקר, בדגש על תובנות צרכניות, בחברות מוצרי צריכה ובסביבה עסקית מורכבת
ניסיון בניהול צוות מחקר, הובלת ספקי מחקר וניהול תקציב שנתי
יכולת הובלה ורתימה במטריצה תוך יצירת השפעה חוצה ללא סמכות ישירה
מומחיות במחקר כמותי ואיכותני, לצד אוריינות דאטה ויכולת לחבר בין מקורות מידע מגוונים
חשיבה אסטרטגית והבנה עסקית ומסחרית, לצד יכולת לתרגם מורכבות לסיפור עסקי חד, המלצות ברורות והשפעה על הנהלה בכירה
אנגלית ברמה גבוהה וניסיון בעבודה עם ממשקים בינלאומיים
למה שטראוס?
שטראוס רואה חשיבות מרכזית בחיבור בין קול הצרכן לבין קבלת החלטות עסקיות ואסטרטגיות. מנהל.ת מרכז תובנות ומחקר בשטראוס מהווה גורם משמעותי בעיצוב מנועי הצמיחה העתידיים של החברה, תוך חיבור בין מחקר, דאטה, חדשנות וצרכים עסקיים. העשייה בתפקיד משפיעה באופן ישיר על פיתוח מוצרים, מהלכים מסחריים וקבלת החלטות ברמות הגבוהות ביותר בארגון.

Description: Come and join a rapidly expanding mobile games company! • Who are we?: SuperPlay is a leading gaming company dedicated to creating unforgettable mobile gaming experiences. Founded in 2019 by industry experts from Playtika and Rovio, the company strives to develop innovative and exciting casual games that captivate millions of players worldwide and remain enjoyable for years to come. • Dice Dreams, our flagship game, has become a global sensation and a top-100-grossing hit, while Domino Dreams, our next big success, is also making a significant impact in the industry. • Our Newest Game – A Magical Collaboration with Disney! • Released in 2025, Disney Solitaire brings beloved Disney stories and characters to life in an unforgettable gaming experience. • Our team, headquartered in Tel Aviv, is made up of talented, passionate, and ambitious professionals. And the future is even more exciting! Want to be part of our journey? Check out the job description below. • What will you do at SuperPlay?: We have petabytes of data, but data isn't insight. Your mission is to be the bridge between raw information and strategic action. This isn't about being a "dashboard provider" - you will be measured by the quality of insights you generate; it's about creating "aha!" moments by going beyond the "what" to uncover the "why" that drives player behavior and shapes our success. • This role is unique: our data is exceptionally clean. There is no ETL or technical pipeline maintenance. Our time is almost exclusively spent on thinking, brainstorming, learning, and researching. • In this role, you will: • Be a strategic partner to our product, design, and leadership teams. Your job is to bring them not just answers, but better questions. You'll translate your findings into compelling, actionable recommendations that catalyze new features, better experiences, and smarter business decisions. • Hypothesize, test, and build frameworks to understand how virtual economies thrive and how player incentives drive long-term engagement. • Embark on deep research projects to deconstruct our most complex business questions. Your deliverable will be a compelling narrative, backed by rigorous analysis, that guides our strategic business roadmap. • Focus on what’s important. We use modern tools (like LLMs) for brainstorming and automating the mundane. Your focus will be on the ambiguous, the complex, and the truly innovative. • Who are you?: Our definition of a good analyst is simple: someone who provides decision-makers with interesting insights. • There are varied archetypes and backgrounds that fit this definition, but some core traits are universal: • 2+ years of experience in the gaming industry/ more than 3 years of experience in Monetization. • You are a first-principles thinker with an innate need to break down complex problems to their fundamental truths. • You possess a deep-seated curiosity to understand human behavior. • You develop strong, data-informed opinions and aren't afraid to voice them. However, you are eager to be challenged and ready to be convinced by new evidence or a better argument. • You can effortlessly translate a complex statistical model into a clear, persuasive story for any audience, with an emphasis on C-level executives. • You are resourceful and self-driven, comfortable navigating uncertainty and motivated to find a path forward even when the way isn't clear • You get bonus points for:: The journey from a complex question to a clear insight is often accelerated by the right tools. Experience with the following is useful for this role (though not required): • A solid understanding of experimental design and A/B testing methodologies. • Proficiency in querying and manipulating large datasets (e.g., strong SQL skills). • Experience using a scripting language like Python for data analysis and automation. • Familiarity with user analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel). • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker). •

Description: We’re looking for a Director of Data to lead the data department and own the company’s data platform, reporting, analytics and data products. The role reports to the EVP Technology. You’ll set the direction for how Tenengroup uses data, including AI. • You’ll own the full chain, from data collection to the numbers leadership uses to make decisions. You’re accountable for the data being available on time and being correct , not just for the pipelines running. You’ll work daily with Marketing, Finance, Merchandising, Product and senior management. You’ll turn their questions into reliable data products and help the business decide how to grow revenue. • Responsibilities: • Strategy and leadership: Set the data and analytics vision and roadmap. Prioritize a large, competing backlog against business impact, and partner with senior management on growth strategy. • Team: Lead and grow the department: Data Engineering, BI & Analytics, and a Data Product Manager. Hire, coach and build a strong engineering and analytics culture. • Lakehouse platform: Own the cloud lakehouse (Databricks / Unity Catalog), plus ingestion, orchestration and CI/CD for data pipelines. Drive a clear medallion/gold-layer architecture, and manage platform cost and performance. • Data trust and reliability: Own production SLAs, monitoring and incident response. Build data-quality gates that check business logic, not just job success. Make sure a pipeline that “succeeded” but loaded bad or missing data gets caught before it reaches a dashboard. • Marketing measurement: Own the data behind media spend, ROAS, attribution and the A/B testing framework, and make sure the statistics are sound. Be the trusted arbiter of “what’s working.” • BI and self-service: Own the BI layer (Tableau). Build governed, certified datasets and one shared set of metric definitions. Keep content, access and licences under control, and move reporting off ad-hoc sources. • AI and a semantic layer: Lead adoption of AI across the data stack. That covers a governed semantic layer that makes natural-language and LLM querying reliable, plus AI-assisted engineering and analysis inside the team. • Documentation and governance: Keep lineage, ownership, documentation and data access policies current. • Requirements: • 5+ years in a data leadership role • People-management experience, preferably including managing team leads • Proven experience building and running a modern cloud data platform (Databricks, Snowflake or BigQuery), including data modeling, orchestration (e.g. Airflow) and data pipelines in production • Strong hands-on SQL, and the ability to review code and data models, not just delegate them • Deep BI experience (Tableau preferred) and a track record of governed, self-service analytics • Solid grounding in experimentation and statistics, and in marketing measurement (attribution, incrementality, ROAS) • A track record of making data trustworthy: data-quality frameworks, observability and SLAs • Clear communicator who can challenge and influence senior stakeholders with data • Advantages: • B2C / D2C e-commerce experience, especially multi-brand or multi-site • Experience with GA4, web event tracking and streaming ingestion (e.g. Kafka) • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to analytics (semantic layers, text-to-SQL, AI agents) • Experience managing platform cost (FinOps) •

The Role
We are seeking a highly hands-on senior architect to lead solution design across enterprise data, analytics, and AI initiatives in a Microsoft-first environment. This role is responsible for translating business requirements into secure, scalable, supportable architectures and guiding delivery teams through design, prototyping, implementation, reviews, and production readiness. Own end-to-end solution architecture for data, analytics, and AI use cases, with accountability for design quality, security, scalability, supportability, and cost.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.

Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to drive alignment across architects, delivery teams, business stakeholders, and enterprise control functions.

Hands-on technical leadership with a clear lead-by-example mindset.
Strong architecture judgment across data, analytics, AI, integration, security, and non-functional requirements.

About the role
We are looking for a commercially sharp Strategy & GTM Lead to join our Data Security Product Management team. This role sits at the intersection of product, sales, marketing and finance — owning pricing and packaging across our data security portfolio (DSPM, DSF, FAM, CipherTrust), running our competitive and win-loss programs, and serving as the commercial bridge between what we build and how we sell it.​
What You'll Own
Pricing & Packaging: Own pricing and packaging strategy across the portfolio — list price, tier and edition design, metering and consumption models, discount architecture, and cross-product bundling.
Competitive Analysis: Own the competitive program — battlecards, positioning, objection handling, and displacement plays that Sales actually uses. Track competitor pricing, packaging, releases, and GTM motion, and translate movement into a recommendation.
Win-Loss Analysis: Build and run a repeatable win-loss program end to end — interview design, execution, and synthesis. Separate the reported loss reason from the real one: product gap, price, packaging, competitive displacement, or sales execution. Close the loop into the roadmap and into enablement.
Pipeline Analysis: Analyze pipeline health by product, segment, and route to market. Find where deals stall, name why, and drive the fix with the accountable owner.
Back Office & Commercial Operations: Serve as Product's interface to the back office.
Field Enablement and GTM: Equip Sales and Sales Engineering to sell on value — pricing guidance, competitive training, and value articulation.
What We're Looking For
Must have:
10+ years in outbound product management, product marketing, pricing strategy, or GTM strategy for enterprise B2B software — with at least 5 years personally owning pricing, competitive, or win-loss outcomes
5+ years in security business
Hands-on ownership of a real pricing or packaging change: what you changed, why, what it did to ASP or win rate, and what you got wrong
Hands on experience with analyzing pipelines and performing win-loss analysis
Experience with leading GTM activities
Ability to influence Sales, Finance, and Operations without authority over any of them
Excellent written and verbal communication
Team player who brings evidence, states plainly when the data is thin, and makes the call anyway
Advantages:
Strong advantage - DSPM market experience — data security posture management, data discovery and classification.
Data Security experience more broadly — DAM, encryption and key management, DLP, data governance
Enterprise security in an adjacent segment — endpoint, network, cloud, identity, or SIEM/SOC
Portfolio spanning both on-premises/hybrid and SaaS, including the pricing tension between them
Consumption or usage-based pricing experience; channel, MSSP, or hyperscaler marketplace motion
Familiarity with the compliance drivers behind data security spend (GDPR, PCI DSS, DORA, NIS2, data residency and sovereignty)
SQL or BI tooling (Tableau, Power BI)

The role
As part of our mission to scale end-to-end embodied AI for autonomous driving, we are building a world-class Data Management team focused on unlocking high-quality, targeted data acquisition that drives model performance and predictability. We are looking for a highly analytical and systems-minded ODD & Behavioral Competency Analyst to lead the analysis of Operational Design Domains (ODDs), traffic patterns, and regulatory behaviors across our target markets.
This role will be critical in defining what data is needed, where, and how much , in order to build models with high Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF) and generalization capabilities across varied geographies.
Key Responsibilities:
ODD Characterization:
Analyze and define the operational design domain (ODD) for each target market or region, including geography, infrastructure, weather, road types, traffic density, and local driving behaviors.
Identify ODD boundaries, edge conditions, and failure triggers to inform data collection and system design.
Behavioral Competency Mapping:
Build and maintain a taxonomy of behavioral competencies (e.g., merging, yielding, unprotected turns, interacting with pedestrians) required to safely operate in each ODD.
Quantify the complexity and frequency of each competency based on local traffic data, regulations, and real-world observations.
ODD Permutation & Scaling Framework:
Develop a framework to compute and prioritize permutations of ODD parameters and behavioral competencies to optimize data collection, scenario coverage, and scaling efficiency.
Recommend minimal data slices needed to support safe and predictable system performance in a new region.
Current model behavioural Pattern Analysis:
Analyze current model kpi patterns, and common driving behaviors, assess differences in required system behavior and edge case risks.
Collaborate with safety and product on findings and proposals for behavioural improvement.
Cross-functional Collaboration:
Work closely with data engineering, safety, simulation, product, and deployment teams to turn ODD and competency insights into actionable data strategies and deployment plans.
Provide input to scenario library development, synthetic data generation, and test case prioritization.
Predictability & MTBF Guidance:
Use historical data and statistical models to identify data gaps or high-variance behaviors that impact MTBF performance.
Provide guidance on what additional data is needed to reach MTBF targets in each ODD segment.
About you
Essential
7+ years experience in systems engineering, automotive data analysis, data science, or a related field.
Experience analyzing or defining ODDs in the context of AV/ADAS technologies is a strong plus.
Familiarity with traffic regulations and human driving behaviors across multiple geographies.
Proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Python, SQL, GIS, Jupyter accessing large pools of data from frameworks like DataBricks) and ability to visualize ODD and scenario coverage metrics.
Ability to work cross-functionally and translate domain analysis into technical and product requirements.
Experience working in an agile, fast-scaling environment with a strong execution mindset.
Desirable:
MS or PhD in Physics, Statistics or Mathematics with specialism in traffic system modeling, autonomous driving deployment, or urban mobility analysis.

Own full-chip and block-level timing closure from synthesis through signoff.

Develop automation scripts to improve timing analysis and reporting.

Static Timing Analysis fundamentals
Timing constraints (SDC)
MCMM timing analysis
Clock tree architecture and clock propagation
Signal Integrity (SI)
OCV, AOCV, POCV, and SOCV methodologies
CRPR and advanced variation modeling
Liberty (.lib), SPEF, SDF, and Verilog formats
Experience with advanced technology nodes (16nm, 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, or similar).

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
Attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
Experience mentoring junior engineers and contributing to technical leadership.

Ownership of timing closure for complex ASIC or SoC designs.
Ability to drive timing signoff independently while collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams.

מחלקת בקרת המכירות של קבוצת אסם-נסטלה מגייסת אנליסט/ית לתפקיד מרכזי בליבת הפעילות המסחרית של החברה. זהו תפקיד המשלב עבודה עם נתונים עסקיים בהיקפים משמעותיים, הפקת תובנות אסטרטגיות ושותפות עסקית עם הנהלת הסחר והמכירות . תחומי אחריות ניתוח ביצועי מכירות מול תקציב, תחזיות ויעדים . בקרה וניהול של תקציבי סחר, הנחות מסחריות והוצאות משתנות . בנייה, תחזוקה והטמעה של מודלי תגמול ויעדי מכירות שנתיים ורבעוניים . עבודה שוטפת מול מנהלי הסחר והמכירות לצורך הפקת תובנות עסקיות וקבלת החלטות . הובלת תהליכי דיווח ובקרה והכנת מצגות ניהוליות להנהלה בכירה . פיתוח ושיפור דוחות וכלי ניתוח ב -Excel וב -Power BI. ניתוח מגמות שוק, ביצועים מסחריים והזדמנויות לשיפור תוצאות עסקיות . עבודה עם מערכות מידע ארגוניות וכלי AI  BI מתקדמים . דרישות התפקיד תואר ראשון בכלכלה – חובה . ניסיון של עד שנה ככלכלן/ית או אנליסט/ית – יתרון . יכולת אנליטית גבוהה וחשיבה עסקית מפותחת . שליטה מלאה ב -Excel, כולל בניית מודלים מורכבים, פונקציות מתקדמות וניתוח נתונים – חובה . היכרות עם Power BI ו -SAP – יתרון משמעותי . אנגלית ברמה גבוהה . יכולת עבודה עצמאית לצד עבודה מול ממשקים רבים בארגון . יכולת הצגת מסרים ונתונים באופן ברור ומשפיע . מה מחכה לך אצלנו ? הזדמנות להשתלב בחברה גלובלית מובילה . חשיפה ישירה לתהליכי קבלת החלטות עסקיות . עבודה עם מאגרי מידע וכלי אנליזה מתקדמים . סביבת עבודה מקצועית, דינמית ומלמדת . אפשרויות להתפתחות מקצועית בעולם הכספים, הסחר והאנליזה העסקית . מיקום : אזור תעשייה חבל מודיעין, שוהם להגשת מועמדות שיתוף ברשתות חברתיות . . . . . test-form-osem מותגים כל המותגים במבה אסם מטרנה אסם-נסטלה פרופשיונל
